# SpeechPhrase

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Speech.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Speech.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Speech/SpeechPhrase.cs#L19)

One thing the trainee is expected to say. Waiting starts with [`Expect()`](/api/vrframework-speech-runtime/SpeechPhrase#expect) - from a
progress step, a UnityEvent or script - and ends at the next sentence the recogniser settles
on: [`OnRecognized`](/api/vrframework-speech-runtime/SpeechPhrase#onrecognized) when it contains what this phrase asks for,
[`OnMissed`](/api/vrframework-speech-runtime/SpeechPhrase#onmissed) when the trainee said something else.

A keyword matches when the recognised text contains it, ignoring case. Joining words with
"+" asks for all of them in any order, which is how a phrase accepts "check the pulse"
and "pulse check" without listing every wording.
